mapper.update: insert into br_material_stock (material_id, mark_type, qty, last_biz_time, update_time) values (#{materialId}, #{markType}, #{qty}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update qty = qty + #{qty}, last_biz_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select qty from br_material_stock where material_id = #{materialId}

select s.material_id, s.mark_type, s.qty, s.last_biz_time, s.update_time, m.material_cd, m.version, m.material_name, m.g_model, m.code_ts, m.calc_unit, m.is_bonded, m.declare_status from br_material_stock s join br_material m on m.id = s.material_id and m.del_flag = '0' where s.material_id = #{materialId}
select biz_type as bizType, ifnull(sum(qty), 0) as qty, count(*) as cnt from br_stock_ledger where material_id = #{materialId} and create_time >= #{monthBegin} group by biz_type
